svg.text: Step 3. Read S/A at the ends → supra or antara
Match the HOMO of one partner with the LUMO of the other (an MO's overall sign is arbitrary, so the first end can always be made to match).
Same symmetry (S+S or A+A) → the second end matches too: suprafacial. Mixed (S+A) → the second end must be reached from the other face: antarafacial.
S + S → H stays on top
S + A → H must cross to the bottom
3 atoms too short → does not occur
hν: an electron is promoted, so the frontier orbital changes symmetry and the answer flips
(photochemical [1,7]-H is suprafacial; photochemical [2+2] is allowed) — L14 p.26; L16 p.25.
